name: baton-relay
description: Worktree-based subagent orchestration plugin for decomposing tasks, dispatching isolated workers, and integrating rebased commits.

interface.shortDescription: Orchestrate subagents through isolated git worktrees and commit handoffs.
interface.longDescription: Provides a manager skill for decomposing work, assigning each bounded task to a fresh subagent in its own git worktree, requiring commit and rebase completion before handoff, and integrating only prepared commits back into the main working branch.
defaultPrompt: Use manager when a task should be planned first and executed by fresh subagents in isolated git worktrees, even if it becomes one job.
Keep the main agent as orchestrator: decompose work, dispatch subagents, verify committed and rebased handoffs, integrate prepared commits, and clean worktrees.
